description: This Java class defines a custom Akka HTTP directive for logging the result of an HTTP request, including status code and duration. It incorporates logging with correlation IDs, measures request processing, and adds trace headers.

classes.name: RequestResultLoggingDirective
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to create an Akka HTTP route that logs request results, including status code and duration, with support for correlation IDs and trace headers.

methods.name: logRequestResult
methods.description: Creates a Route that wraps an inner Route with logging functionality to record request method, URI, status code, and trace information, with correlation ID support.
